gold_scientific_questions.question: Can petabase-scale mining of public sequencing data uncover a large hidden RNA-virus/RdRP diversity that is absent from curated viral reference databases?
required_elements: absence from curated viral reference databases
acceptable_variants: Does exhaustive mining of public sequence archives reveal RNA viruses (via RdRP) that current reference databases miss?
How much uncatalogued RdRP-defined RNA-virus diversity is hidden in petabase-scale public sequencing data?
unacceptable_variants: Which species in this dataset are pathogenic to humans?
What is the average GC content of the sequences in the files?

gold_scientific_questions.question: How does the diversity of newly recovered RdRP-defined sOTUs compare in scale to existing curated viral reference databases when public sequencing archives are exhaustively screened?
acceptable_variants: By what factor does the count of RdRP-based sOTUs exceed the viruses catalogued in reference databases?
unacceptable_variants: Which sample has the most reads?
